name: demo-project
description: Demo Project - Modern Photography Management Full-Stack SaaS

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,PREPROD" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run pre-production:server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
